witness.title: Geʽez text of Hiob Ludolf's 1701 Ethiopic Psalter, digitized and retyped by Ran HaCohen
witness.date_statement: 1701 printed edition; digital transcription date not established here
witness.repository_or_publisher: Tel Aviv University source site; local archival capture by Ethiopian Bible Library
witness.shelfmark_or_edition_id: Psalterium Davidis aethiopice et latine, Frankfurt am Main, 1701
witness.editorial_policy: Uses the TAU Rahlfs-numbered page sequence. Source page text and numbering anomalies are preserved. No independent collation.

coverage.structure_description: 151 ordered TAU Rahlfs-numbered pages with 2,537 extracted nonempty numbered units; headings retained where separable.
coverage.supplements_and_editorial_signs: Source label gaps, duplicates, and nonnumeric markers are retained as found; 10 pages contain non-consecutive, duplicate, or nonnumeric labels. No attempt was made to restore text or labels.
coverage.numbering_policy: Preserves the TAU page sequence and marker labels exactly as parsed; these are source labels, not a newly asserted canonical verse system.

review_dimensions.scope: TAU source index and notes identify the Ludolf 1701 Ethiopic Psalter and HaCohen transcription.
151 ordered page titles and nonempty numbered units in local capture.
HTML marker-span structure was extracted; verse wording was not independently compared to print.
No independent collation against the 1701 print or manuscript witnesses.
The full 151-page local sequence was captured; completeness against print or manuscript witnesses is unknown.
Source notice and required noncommercial attribution are included with each archive copy.

additional_notes: Geʽez source transcription, not an English translation. Source warnings about possible new typos remain applicable.
